description: This file defines the PHP client class 'CodePipelineClient' for interacting with the Amazon CodePipeline service using the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to CodePipeline, such as creating, deleting, and managing pipelines and jobs.

classes.name: CodePipelineClient
classes.description: The client class providing methods to interact with Amazon CodePipeline service.

methods.name: acknowledgeJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously acknowledges a job in CodePipeline.

methods.name: createPipeline
methods.description: Creates a new pipeline in CodePipeline.

methods.name: startPipelineExecution
methods.description: Starts the execution of a pipeline.
